violations.text: (Shelled eggs) was observed held at (71 ) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC voluntarily disposed of product. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

The door to the outside, located in the (dining room ), is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
(Various food product ) were observed stored on the floor in the (outside wall in cooler). Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
Outside area behind trailers have an accumulation of trash, litter, and/or other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
The (walls ) in the (kitchen ) area is in poor repair. Observed holes and cracks The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/21/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the (back kitchen ) do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (bar, kitchen, and outside ) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 08/21/2026
Dry ingredients were observed stored on the floor in the kitchen. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 03/27/2024
